item.name: Zookeeper Camp
item.description:
#Kids in San Diego will get to experience what it’s like to have an awesome career with animals with Animal Care Camp. 

##Duration
6 Hours | 9am-3pm

##About
This one-day camp involves unique hands-on activities from our professional animal care staff to give campers experiences with the different aspects of animal husbandry. This includes: diet preparation, animal exercise, enrichment strategies, training sessions, and more. Campers will be encouraged to follow their passion and explore their skills with animals of all kinds, such as large and small mammals, reptiles, and birds. Spots are extremely limited, so register today!
item.booking_notes:
**CAMP INFORMATION**
**Camp Hours:** 9:00 AM - 3:00 PM
**Check In:** 8:45am – 9:00am
**Check Out:** 3:00pm – 3:15pm

**CHECK-IN PROCEDURE**
You can wait by our lobby and when check-in begins a side gate will be opened. Staff with clipboards will be there to check you in 10 minutes prior to start time. Once checked in, parents are free to leave and campers will be directed to their class table to place down their items and get their nametag. Once check-in has finished the class Instructor will assemble all the campers to go over expectations, the schedule of the day, and begin! During check-in, please verify that whoever is picking your child up is on the "authorized to pick up" list. This helps to ensure the safety of the children.

**CHECK-OUT PROCEDURE**
Anyone picking up a camper must be prepared to show ID to the camp staff and must have their name on the "authorized to pick up" list. If you plan to check-out early, come to the main office and we will have your child brought to the office. Please do not disrupt any class in progress. Adults and non-campers are not allowed in the camp areas unless escorted by staff.

**CHECK-OUT PROCEDURE**
Anyone picking up a camper must be prepared to show ID to the camp staff and must have their name on the "authorized to pick up" list. If you plan to check-out early, come to the main office and we will have your child brought to the office. Please do not disrupt any class in progress. Adults and non-campers are not allowed in the camp areas unless escorted by staff.

**LATE FEE POLICY**
You will be charged a late fee of $15 beginning 10 minutes after the end of check out for each child who has not been picked up. That fee will be applied every additional 15 minutes thereafter.

**MEDICATION**
We must have a signed medical authorization release in order to give any medications to campers, which you can fill out during check-in and drop off any medication with the staff if it's needed by your child. Medications will be safely stored in the office. Please remember to pick them up at check-out.

**AIDES**
If your child has an aide at school and you plan to have them attend with your child, or if you need to attend with your child, please call us at 858-756-4117 ext. 406 so that we can help them complete the fingerprint process. All aides MUST complete fingerprinting in order to attend and this process includes a livescan fee (paid to the livescan facility) and can take days or weeks to get results back.

**WHAT TO BRING**
* **Lunch**: Please pack lunches labeled with camper’s name. Lunches will be kept in the classroom. We do not have a refrigerator for campers and we do not have the ability to warm or cook lunches.
* **Snack**: Please let your child know what you have packed for snacks as opposed to lunch – otherwise some children will eat their entire lunch during snack time and have nothing left for lunch. Remember to label your child’s food.
* **Water bottle**: Please pack a water bottle and be sure to label it with your child’s first and last name. We have a filtered water dispenser for refills throughout the day.
* **Comfortable clothes**: Have your child dress in comfortable clothes that are ok to get dirty. Dress in layers as needed by weather.
* **Sunscreen**: Children are half indoors and half outdoors with shaded areas. If you choose, you may leave sunscreen labeled with your name so your child can reapply sunscreen mid-day. Please let your child’s teacher know.
* **Cell phones/cameras**: Phones, cameras, and tablets may be brought. Your child can use them when instructed to help capture your child's experience, but only photos of the animals/activities can occur. Not all parents authorize pictures to be taken of their child. Please be mindful children are responsible for the items they bring.

**WHAT NOT TO BRING**
* **Shoes**: For safety reasons, closed-toed shoes only. No sandals allowed.
* **Drawstrings**: For safety reasons, drawstrings (hoodies, pants or shorts) should not be worn on the playground.
* **Pets**: No pets are allowed on the campgrounds. There are no exceptions to this safety policy. Cannot leave pets alone in vehicles.
* **Toys, books, stuffed animals, etc.**: These may get soiled, broken, or lost—best to leave at home.
* **Sharp objects**: For safety purposes please leave anything that is a sharp or hazardous at home.

**DISCIPLINE POLICY**
Our camp staff are well trained and expected to resolve behavior issues in a positive manner. Our goal is to provide every child with a rewarding camp experience. At the beginning of the camp day, the camp teacher goes over camp rules. In the event that a rule is broken, the teacher gives the class a reminder. If the same child breaks a rule again, a verbal reminder directed at that child is issued including stating the problem and a solution. If a rule is broken again, the teacher will send the child to the office to think about the problem and discuss the problem/solution with the camp leadership. The camp leadership will call home to discuss behavior and a solution plan. Examples of behavior that will result in a camper being immediately asked to leave camp include, but are not limited to: destruction of property or disruptive behavior which threatens the safety of other campers, animals, volunteers, or staff. In such a case, camp fees are non-transferable and non-refundable.

item.cancellation_notes:
Please stay home if a member of your household is sick. We can transfer registrations which haven't started, to another day if that day has room, for any purpose. Communicate with us about child illness and we can discuss the cancellation policy allowances.

If you need to cancel and provide more than 24 hours’ notice to the start of the camp day, we can refund you 85% of the paid value.

If you need to cancel with less than 24 hours’ notice to the start of the day you will not receive a refund.
